channel.title: Algeria - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Algeria, every source cited.

item.title: Russia vetoes US resolution on Western Sahara autonomy plan
item.description: Morocco's plan for Western Sahara autonomy faced international setback after Russia's veto of a US resolution.

item.title: Algeria in talks to supply fertilizer to Bangladesh
item.description: Bangladesh, which imports 80% of its fertilizer, is seeking supply agreements with Algeria.

item.title: Algerian president pardons 5,539 prisoners
item.description: President Abdelmadjid Tebboune granted presidential pardon to 5,539 inmates on the 72nd anniversary of the Revolution.
